_comment: MuseScore archive pieces (PDMX, Long et al. 2025, https://zenodo.org/records/15571083): public domain or CC0 as declared by the uploader, with no licence conflict. Chosen and gated by content/tools/pdmx_select.py, pdmx_gate.py and pdmx_fragments.py; the notes say what was checked. No individual engraving review: the gates are the review. Not shipped: 3118 failed a gate (one staff, a lint law error, an unplayable slice or an XSD error), 157 duplicates of another piece (dedupe.py), 17 out of scope (pdmx_scope.py), 3913 passed but ranked beyond the cap of 1300 pieces at levels 1 to 4 (by rating; level 5 is not capped). Their reasons are in content/_raw/pdmx/gate.jsonl, which is not committed; `rejected` lists only the candidates the build refused.
